name: 黑棺·终结
description: 目标回合结束时结算黑棺的第二段伤害。
skillCode: var target = context.rulePiece; if (!target || context.playerId !== target.ownerPlayerId) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (!(target.statusTags || []).some(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'aizen-black-coffin'; })) { removeRuleById(target.instanceId, 'rule-aizen-black-coffin-end'); return { success: false, message: '' }; } var tags = (target.statusTags || []).filter(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'aizen-black-coffin' && tag.appliedTurn !== battle.turn.turnNumber; }); var messages = []; for (var tag of tags) { if (target.currentHp <= 0) break; var source = battle.pieces.concat(battle.graveyard || []).find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === tag.sourceId; }); if (!source) throw new Error('Black coffin damage source is unavailable'); var result = dealDamage(source, target, tag.delayedDamage, 'magical', battle, 'aizen-black-coffin-delayed'); removeStatusEffectById(target.instanceId, tag.id); messages.push('黑棺终结，对' + target.name + '造成' + result.damage + '点魔法伤害'); } return { success: messages.length > 0, message: messages.join('；') };
